description_en: Submits a cloud service configuration check
kebab_example: aliyun sas submit-check --scan-range POLICY --task-source YAO_CHI --resource-directory-account-id 1276085894170000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitCheck

parameters.help_en:
The check scope. Valid values:
FULL: Scans all check items.
POLICY: Scans check items of custom configurations
parameters.help_zh:
检查范围，取值：
FULL：扫描所有检查项
POLICY：扫描自定义配置的检查项
parameters.name: scan_range

parameters.help_en: The policy ID. This parameter takes effect only when ScanRange is set to POLICY. You can obtain the value by calling the ListCheckConfigs operation. If this parameter is not specified or is set to default, the scan is triggered based on the system default policy. If the default policy does not exist, NoDefaultStrategy is returned. If another value is specified, the scan is triggered based on the check items of the specified policy. If the policy does not exist or does not belong to the current account, IllegalParam is returned. This parameter is ignored when ScanRange is set to FULL or FREE
parameters.help_zh: 策略 ID，仅在 ScanRange 为 POLICY 时生效，可通过 ListCheckConfigs 获取。不传或传 default 时按系统默认策略触发，默认策略不存在时返回 NoDefaultStrategy；传入其他值时按该策略的检查项触发，策略不存在或不属于当前账号时返回 IllegalParam。ScanRange 为 FULL 或 FREE 时忽略该参数
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en:
The source of the task. Valid values:

YAO_CHI: ApsaraDB console
parameters.help_zh:
任务来源。取值：

YAO_CHI：瑶池控制台
parameters.name: task_source

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the member accounts of the resource folder belong.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号 ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id
